scenario.description: A data engineering team is tasked with overhauling an existing batch processing system for supply chain logistics data. The primary goal is to improve data quality, processing efficiency, and ensure regulatory compliance. A critical constraint for all data transformations is the mandatory use of Apache Spark's DataFrame API with Scala, explicitly forbidding Python/PySpark for performance and consistency reasons across the existing ecosystem. Furthermore, all outgoing data feeds to external partners must be encrypted end-to-end using 'TLS 1.3 with AES-256 GCM' cipher suites, rejecting any weaker encryption standards like TLS 1.2. The team consists of a Data Platform Architect, a Senior ETL Developer, a Data Quality Engineer, a Security Auditor, and a DevOps Engineer. The task uses a branching tree communication structure, so critical information must remain consistent as it is distributed from an upstream coordinator to specialized downstream agents. The goal is to build a high-quality, secure, and compliant data pipeline.
